about.intro_content: Prof. Quan Zhang is Professor, Doctoral Advisor and Deputy Director of the Department of Head and Neck Surgery at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC), Guangzhou. He has worked in head and neck tumour diagnosis and treatment since 1987.
about.detailed_content: Prof. Zhang is especially skilled in function-preserving treatment of laryngeal cancer, thyroid carcinoma, microwave tissue coagulation for early oral cancer, and neck dissection. He has published 27 research papers since 2004 and contributed to 8 academic monographs as associate editor or editorial board member. His research includes prognostic factors in laryngeal squamous cell carcinoma, sentinel lymph node biopsy versus elective neck dissection for tongue cancer, and molecular mechanisms of chemotherapeutic resistance in laryngeal cancer.

faq.section_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Prof. Quan Zhang

items.question: Does Prof. Quan Zhang accept international patients?
items.answer: CancerFax can coordinate medical report review and consultation support for international patients seeking an opinion related to head and neck cancer at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, subject to hospital availability and case acceptance.

items.question: What is Prof. Zhang's area of specialisation?
items.answer: Prof. Zhang specialises in function-preserving surgery for laryngeal cancer, thyroid carcinoma, and oral cancer, including neck dissection.

items.question: How can I request a consultation or second opinion?
items.answer: Submit your medical reports through CancerFax. The CancerFax team reviews the documents, prepares the case for submission, and coordinates next steps with SYSUCC's International Medical Center, subject to availability.

items.question: What does function-preserving laryngeal cancer surgery involve?
items.answer: Function-preserving surgery aims to remove the tumour while retaining as much voice and swallowing function as possible; Prof. Zhang has particular expertise in this approach, including laryngeal framework reconstruction.

items.question: Is Prof. Zhang involved in research on laryngeal cancer prognosis?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Zhang has published research on inflammation- and nutrition-based prognostic scoring systems, as well as molecular mechanisms of chemotherapy resistance, in laryngeal squamous cell carcinoma.
